skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Achieve B2 level proficiency in Vietnamese language (listening, speaking, reading, writing) as per the Vietnamese language proficiency framework for foreigners.
Gain understanding of Vietnamese culture, society, education, and economy.
Develop the ability to independently learn and practice Vietnamese language skills.
Learn to effectively search and utilize information from various sources.
Apply critical thinking in understanding and discussing various topics in Vietnamese.
Participate in group activities and discussions to enhance language skills.
Improve active listening skills in Vietnamese.
Develop fluent and coherent oral communication skills in Vietnamese.
Enhance reading comprehension and summarization skills in Vietnamese.
Improve detailed and clear writing skills in Vietnamese.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for assessments.
